page_note: 该页是一张跨页延续的OECD小多图（15个国家面板），以阶梯折线比较2019年5月至2024年5月各国名义与实际最低工资的累计变化百分比，无图号、无标题、无资料来源行。

figures.value_axis_ticks: Japan, Korea, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Portugal, Slovak Republic, Slovenia, Spain, United Kingdom: -20, -10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60; Latvia, Lithuania: -30, -15, 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75; Mexico: -60, -30, 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150; Poland: -40, -20, 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100; Türkiye: -200, 0, 200, 400, 600, 800

components.evidence: 15 identical time-series panels from `Japan` to `United Kingdom` in a 3-column grid
each panel carries its own bold name above it: `Japan`, `Korea`, `Latvia`, ... `United Kingdom`
one legend strip `Nominal minimum wage` / `Real minimum wage` at page top governs all 15 panels
grey legend band sits above the first row of panels, outside them
Japan tops at 60, Latvia at 75, Mexico at 150, Poland at 100, Türkiye at 800
both lines move in flat treads and vertical risers at wage-uprating dates, e.g. Mexico, Poland
Latvia real line falls to about -10 below the zero rule; axes print -20, -30, -60, -200
a heavy black horizontal rule at 0 crosses every panel
`May-19`, `Nov-19` ... `May-24` set at roughly 45 degrees under every panel
time written as `May-19`, `Nov-22`, `May-24` rather than ISO dates
monthly series but only 11 ticks, one every six months, from `May-19` to `May-24`
each plot area carries a light grey fill instead of white
faint white vertical rules at the six-month positions inside the grey panels, no horizontal rules
15 panels x 2 series x ~61 monthly points is well over 1000 plotted points

difficulty_notes: 面板上没有任何数字标注，全部取值必须对着刻度目测。多数面板刻度间距为10个百分点，而5%容差对小值极为苛刻：`9`只允许±0.45，即不足一个刻度格的1/22；`12`只允许±0.6。Türkiye面板刻度为0,200,400,600,800，一格200，读`700`需落在±35内，也就是一格的1/6，而阶梯线本身线宽已占数个百分点。加上15个面板五种不同量程（60/75/150/100/800），无法把一个面板的像素比例迁移到另一个面板，读数精度是最先失守的一环；相比之下面板名（粗体）与系列名（图例）都可直接抄录。
